result.evidence_quote: Patients with heart disease, hypertension, and diabetes had a considerably greater incidence of severe COVID-19, with computed odds ratios (ORs) of 1.50, 1.34, and 2.89, respectively, indicating that diabetes was the best predictor of severity in this cohort.
result.rationale: Heart disease and hypertension are examined as predictors of COVID-19 severity. This is peripheral to cardiovascular medicine because the study focuses on infectious disease outcomes rather than cardiovascular outcomes, cardiovascular risk prediction, or cardiovascular therapies.
